approved_boundary: Add a narrowly scoped recovery transition that reuses the original exact unresolved action claim, same task and lease identity, complete claimed resource set, and latest fencing tokens. It may durably record a separately authorized compensation start and receipt after lease expiry, while holding the existing call-span resource locks. It may consume the original claim only after fresh target verification proves the compensation outcome.
rejected_boundaries: Release the original unresolved claim before compensation target verification.
Acquire a normal replacement lease or create a second claim for the same unresolved action resources.
Use the transition to replay the original action or execute a non-compensation action.
Enable real external actions or grant commit, push, merge, deploy, release, or external-communication authority.
authority_effect: Authorizes the minimum ADR, Spec, Impact, Plan, Test Plan, repository protocol, deterministic fake adapter, tests, evidence, and independent review changes needed for this recovery-claim compensation transition. All other Authority Envelope restrictions remain unchanged.
